初めまして、ルイと申します。
以前、他の方がリクエストしていたキャラクターたちのイラストをもっとotex様の絵柄で見たいと思い、メッセージをお送りしました。
______________________________

◆一条 絵梨香(銀髪の女性)
女性/29歳/175cm(ヒール込み)
王子様のような人。大人の女性。イギリスと日本のハーフ。

◆一条 レイラ(茶髪の少女)
女性/21歳/154cm
天真爛漫で、可憐なお姫様のような少女。

◆関係性
お互いを”運命の人”だと思う程に、大切に想い合っている。

可能であれば、絵梨香がレイラに額にキスを落としているシチュエーションだと嬉しいです。

以下、資料です。
https://x.com/trpg_rui_/status/1774809777010569713?s=46&t=G_pAjeXUMLRpTcnlG77l-Q

https://x.com/trpg_rui_/status/1744278903362146305?s=46&t=G_pAjeXUMLRpTcnlG77l-Q
______________________________

金額等が見合わなければ再送して頂けたらと思います。
ご検討の程、よろしくお願い致します。

Thank you so much for the last artwork you made for me, I absolutely love it!

I would like to request another if possible!

This would be for my upcoming birthday, so the theme would be a birthday celebration. If it's not too selfish of me, would love to see what you come up with. You're welcome to dress my model in any outfit you want, any hairstyle and do any pose. 

Thank you for  considering this request!

If possible, please separate character from background. I would like to use it for social media purposes and thumbnails in future (with credit) and this would be very helpful.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Y1gN2VbroFVzlElV2VfjKduaGrlEatO2

Hi there!

I would like to request a drawing of my Vtuber model, featuring both sides as different girls. 
For the pose, I would like a pose that shows the duality of the two sides (the white hair one and the black hair one). Something like holding hands and having their chest pressed against each other, while looking at the "viewer". 
I provided several references to show what I mean, but feel free to be creative and do your own idea if it reflects the duality better in your opinion!
White hair is more submissive, black hair is dominant. 
For outfit, I would like a bunny girl outfit - the body suit, bunny ears etc. The references provide an example. 
Thank you so much for your consideration! I really love the way you draw eyes and the style in general.

The art will be displayed on social media (Twitter/Twitch/YouTube) with credit to you.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Y1gN2VbroFVzlElV2VfjKduaGrlEatO2?usp=share_link
